about_the_game:
This is the official soundtrack featuring terunon’s original compositions for "Absented Age 2: Ghostbound".

It includes 32 tracks from the game, provided in higher quality MP3 format than was used in the game for improved listening enjoyment.

Each track is associated with an in-game artist, and their unique musical styles are vividly reflected in the compositions.

We invite you to enjoy not only the music but also the unique world they help create!

Additionally, Anecdotes about each artist are included from the sound staff at Yozakurajo Hall.

●Sado Band Club / Absented Age

An eccentric school band founded by Hayato, a high school keyboardist with a complicated past, after leaving the brass band club.

Trumpet player Karen’s performance, described as “sucking you in, akin to obsession,” has quietly sent shockwaves through the indie music scene.

While Hayato is the main composer, a unique trait of the band is that all core members have songwriting skills.

Karen specializes in brass band music, Hayato in EDM and ballads, and Suzu in ethnic music.

●Amaguribashi High School Brass Band / Ancestors

A school band formed by the top members of the Amaguribashi High School Brass Band.

Located in a region known for its strong ties to the entertainment industry, the school has become a fairly competitive presence.

Despite their high level of skill, the band maintains a relaxed and easygoing atmosphere — but thanks to their charismatic leader Rumi, a horn player, they have outstanding unity and discipline.

They excel at jazz.

There’s a mysterious male member who, despite never appearing in public,

is exceptionally skilled on the marimba, and he is sometimes the topic of jokes and memes on places like the Super Live Summary site.

● Minamino, H. et. al. (MHE)

A four-member band from a neighboring town, consisting of three high school students and one university student.

They used to focus on idol pop songs, but ever since rumors spread about their pianist-composer’s disappearance,

their style has shifted toward ambient and ballads, giving rise to a darker, more introspective atmosphere.

● The 3rd Dominator

Once hailed as a child prodigy, this is the name Hayato used as a middle school musician.

As an early pioneer of the bedroom production boom, he enjoyed a meteoric rise before quietly disappearing from the public eye due to personal circumstances.

This music included in this soundtrack is not intended for use in derivative works.

However, it may be used as background audio in videos or livestreams directly related to Absented Age.

※ Use of the music in videos or other media where the primary purpose is to distribute or showcase the music itself is expressly not allowed.

short_description: This is the original soundtrack featuring the BGM that colors the world of Absented Age. Enjoy the emotional and distinctive music brought to life by the in-game groups, including the protagonist Karen, a trumpet player, and bands like the Sado Band Club and the Amaguribashi High School Brass Band.
